title: Ukrainian Mirage 2000 shoots down Russian jet drone with gun
big: 7 new stories. The top five are mostly about drones and allies.

stories.h: Ukrainian Mirage 2000 shoots down Russian jet drone with gun
stories.what: A French-supplied Mirage 2000 fighter shot down a Russian jet-powered attack drone with its built-in cannon, according to footage released by Ukraine’s Air Force. The Air Force published the video with a short caption.
stories.you: A French-supplied Mirage 2000 fighter shot down a Russian jet-powered attack drone with its built-in cannon.

stories.h: Russian corvette reportedly destroyed in blast at Libyan port
stories.what: A Russian Navy missile corvette caught fire after a large explosion in the Libyan port of Benghazi and is “almost certainly destroyed,” according to a report by naval analyst H I Sutton published Sunday.
stories.you: A Russian Navy missile corvette caught fire after a large explosion in the Libyan port of Benghazi and is “almost certainly destroyed,”.

stories.h: Canada joins NATO innovation fund, promises ‘business as usual’ with US
stories.what: HALIFAX, Nova Scotia —Hours after news broke that the United States would limit defense cooperation with Canada, the Canadian government announced plans to pour 100 million Canadian dollars into a NATO defense-innovation fund.
stories.you: NATO ordered limits on the relationship in this story.

stories.h: Maker of combat-proven Ukraine drone courts US special forces
stories.what: The company behind the Nightmare FPV, a kamikaze drone that has flown by the thousands in Ukraine, set up a booth at Fort Bragg’s Modern Warfare Week this month.
stories.you: The company behind the Nightmare FPV, a kamikaze drone that has flown by the thousands in Ukraine, set up a booth at Fort Bragg’s Modern Warfare Week this month.

stories.h: U.S. Army tests commercial shotgun shells to stop drones
stories.what: U.S. Army soldiers at Fort Benning, Georgia, fired four kinds of 12-gauge shotgun ammunition at small target drones to see which loads could bring them down, the service said this week. The live-fire assessment ran Sept. 21-22 at Bryant Range.
stories.you: U.S. Army soldiers at Fort Benning, Georgia, fired four kinds of 12-gauge shotgun ammunition at small target drones to see which loads could bring them down, the service said this week.
